headline: Check Forest Park Access for Seasonal Closures
reservation: Access to the primary forest trails is generally open to the public via Slieve Gullion Forest Park. Visitors should verify official status before travel as the area is a working forest and trails may be subject to diversions or temporary closures.

days.title: Slieve Gullion Forest and Peaks

stops.name: Slieve Gullion Forest Park
stops.detail: Walk the Forest Nature Reserve Woodland Trail at Hawthorn Hill to see oak and beech trees once part of the Chambre Demesne. The path offers views of Croslieve, Slievebrack, and Mullaghbane Mountains.

days.driving: Allow 20-30 minutes for the short drive from Newry; conditions vary.
days.note: The Hawthorn Hill trail involves moderately steep sections on graded off-road paths.

intel.title: Working Forest Status
intel.text: The Forest Nature Reserve trails are part of a working forest environment. Visitors must check for on-site signage regarding temporary trail diversions or closures.

intel.title: Daylight Utilization
intel.text: Plan woodland walks during daylight hours to safely navigate moderately steep terrain. Trails start and finish at the designated forest park car park.

intel.title: Forest Park Parking
intel.text: The primary trailhead for the one-mile Hawthorn Hill loop is located at the Slieve Gullion Forest Park car park. Evidence does not specify current parking capacity or fees.

intel.title: Supply and Fuel Gap
intel.text: Available evidence does not list fuel stations within the AONB boundary. Travelers should refuel in nearby gateway towns like Newry before heading into the forest park.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: The source material does not confirm mobile signal strength within the woodland valleys. Carry a physical map or download trail details before entering Slieve Gullion.

plan.arrival: Arrive via Newry, pick up supplies, and proceed to the Slieve Gullion Forest Park car park to begin the woodland trails.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the paved access roads; check local rental agreements for any off-road restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Slieve Gullion slopes offer views of the surrounding mountains, though visibility is season-dependent.
